title.zh: ARK 与 Securitize 合作在以太坊上代币化 ARK 风险基金
title.en: ARK partners with Securitize to tokenize ARK Venture Fund on Ethereum

current_state.zh: ARK Invest已通过Securitize在以太坊上将其13亿美元的ARK Venture Fund（ARKVX）代币化，该基金持有OpenAI、Anthropic和Stripe等仓位；美国零售投资者可以500美元最低门槛参与，流动性限于季度回购要约。
current_state.en: ARK Invest has tokenized its $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX) on Ethereum via Securitize, with holdings including OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe; US retail investors can access it with a $500 minimum, with liquidity limited to quarterly repurchase offers.

updates.title_zh: ARK Invest 通过 Securitize 将 13 亿美元风投基金上链
updates.title_en: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
updates.what_changed_zh:
ARK Invest 正通过 Securitize 将其规模 13 亿美元的 ARK Venture Fund（ARKVX）代币化，该基金持有 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Stripe 的股份，代币发行首先在以太坊上进行，未来可能扩展至其他链。美国散户投资者可通过 Securitize 认购，而基金赎回仍仅限于季度回购要约。

此举将原本难以触及的非上市科技公司敞口以代币化形式呈现，扩大了链上渠道对这类资产的准入。Securitize 负责链上发行与投资者体验环节。

Securitize 是一家以 SECZ 为代码的美国上市公司，为该发行提供受监管的代币化基础设施。ARKVX 的代币化权益首先在以太坊上发行，其他链被描述为后续可能的扩展方向。
updates.what_changed_en: Cathie Wood's ARK is partnering with Securitize to tokenize its Venture Fund — which holds stakes including OpenAI and Anthropic — initially on Ethereum, with plans to expand to other chains.
